scope: Separate portable C++ producer/checker for one quadratic Boolean residual, with packed original ANFs and original-equation witnesses only. No full-query integration or timing claim.
exhaustive: Every ordered pair of Boolean polynomials in one/two variables and quadratic polynomials in three variables
real_controls: Replay all 162 frozen branch identifiers in fixtures/frozen-controls.json against the original round40 ANFs; no branch selection based on native outcomes.
correctness: Native complete roots equal the independent Python affine checker and complete truth transform. Native witnesses are independently recomputed from original equations. Reordered/duplicate/empty witnesses preserve roots. Nonlinear and malformed witnesses are rejected. Rank is recomputed by the checker.
failure_controls: Work, assignment and output-capacity failures leave output_count zero and caller sentinel buffers unchanged. Test high equation bits, both limbs, duplicate parity, changed original equations, zero/rank-deficient systems, context reuse, concurrent calls and closed handles.
work_boundary: Bounded implementation work units: input term visits and word XORs; producer row visits/elimination XORs/output words; checker witness visits/coefficient parities, affine pivot-search visits/row visits, candidate visits/pivot reconstruction/feature visits/evaluation XORs, root-sort comparisons/uniqueness checks/output roots. Fixed workspace initialization, scalar bookkeeping and memory moves are not total-operation measurements. Charge failures; do not call this an IC operation count.
performance_gate: This package has no performance protocol or timing claim. Require a separately frozen complete-query comparison after independent correctness and portable builds.
